items.question: How does Chiefy protect my email data?
items.answer: Your security is our top priority. We use OAuth 2.0 for secure authentication with both Google and Microsoft. Email content is encrypted at rest using client-side field-level encryption, and we follow the principle of least privilege for API access. For our Google integration, we undergo Google's annual CASA security assessment.

items.question: How does the email summary feature work?
items.answer: Chiefy uses advanced AI to analyze your email threads and generate a concise overview highlighting the key points, decisions, and action items. This helps you quickly understand the context without reading the entire thread.

items.question: What permissions does Chiefy need?
items.answer: Chiefy requires access to your emails to provide summaries, extract action items, generate content, and send your emails. We only request permissions we absolutely need. You can review and revoke these permissions at any time in your Google Account or Microsoft Account settings.

items.question: What's included in the free trial?
items.answer: The 14-day free trial includes full access to all Pro features: unlimited email summaries, action item extraction, AI email writer (generating emails and drafts without any limits), and custom email templates. Sign in with Google or Microsoft to start saving time on email management.

items.question: Can I use Chiefy with other email providers?
items.answer: Chiefy supports Gmail, Google Workspace, and Microsoft Outlook. Sign in with your Google or Microsoft account to get started.
